title: BLACKOUT//ENGINE (full length)
description: DaemonV12: 72 bars of industrial hip-hop, 128 BPM, G minor, exactly 2:15. Living Bass riff, Mechanical Orchestra engine room and bells, Impossible Voice lament and song.

tracks.description: V12 IRON PULSE at D2 + skin slap D3 (knock) + log rim D5 (click); humanised +-2.5 ms.
The hammer: TITANIUM CRACK -2 st + HEADLINER context snare + skin slap G3 + gated alien bar; laid back 5-9 ms; ghosts, flams, drags.
Alien modal bar gated to anvil taps; a dotted-eighth echo.
The breaker: contact click, then the lever stop (bars 19 and 60).
Living Bass below 110 Hz (LR4): the clean phase-locked sub, mono, ducked under every kick.
Living Bass above 110 Hz (LR4): the folded, geared, driven body, saturated again for small speakers.
Impossible Voice: ghost cries, the lament and the cut-off answer, chopped by the machine, the high stair and climb.
Impossible Voice, human: the whole song, the hum, C5 -> B4 over the last cadence; a G-major glass halo blooms on the last note.
Hook B on the struck bar (bounced) and buzzing tine; echoes, triplet sequences, wedges, tolls, the music box and the last chords; the gong.
Friction-bowed bars: the open-fifth hum in the collapse, the chords of the transformation, the slow chromatic climb of the climax.
Hand Skin: the gear-change fills, the talking drum of the transformation, palm booms, the hands of the warm ending.
Escapement clock, hollow log, dispersive spring: the engine room.
Tuned bearings: hot metal ticking as it cools after each blackout.
The shared rack room (FDN, wet only): low under the grooves, open after each blackout.
